d:
Laxmi along with her husband Kishtaya, who is a deaf-mute work for the landlord. The landlord's son, Surya, returns home to look after the estate, as well as formalize his marriage to Saroj. Shortly thereafter Kishtaya leaves Laxmi. Surya finds her attractive and starts an intimate relationship with her. Will this relationship ever come in limelight?
